title: Reference Gradient Page — Single Minimal Reference Screen

requirements.summary: Replace the existing multi-section UI with a single full-screen reference page containing only the background image, gradient overlay, centered reference text, and one primary button.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the app shows a single full-viewport page without the existing Scnned sections, top nav, or footer.
The page contains exactly one prominent centered text element with: Reference #: CSN-8403D-PDF-18932
The page includes one primary button (CTA) visible above the fold on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Create a single minimal full-screen page that renders (1) a generated background image, (2) a gradient overlay, (3) centered text reading exactly "Reference #: CSN-8403D-PDF-18932", and (4) one primary CTA button. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the primary button styling/behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Replace the current root UI rendering (CoffeeLandingPage) with the new ReferencePage so the existing sections/top nav/footer are no longer shown.

requirements.summary: Implement layered background composition (static generated image + semi-transparent gradient overlay) with readable centered content across viewports.
acceptanceCriteria: The background image loads from a static file under frontend/public/assets/generated.
A semi-transparent gradient overlay is visually present above the image.
Text and button remain readable on common screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) without clipping.

file_operations.description: Implement the layered layout: bottom layer uses the static image at frontend/public/assets/generated/reference-bg.dim_1920x1080.png, gradient overlay layer above it, and centered content above both; ensure responsive sizing and adequate contrast for the centered text and primary button. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the CTA. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Remove/disable the global body::before decorative texture layer so the app visually contains only the required single-page background image + gradient overlay (no extra background textures).

requirements.summary: Link the primary button to the specified external URL on the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: The link behavior is implemented purely on the frontend (no backend changes required).

file_operations.description: Wire the single primary CTA button to navigate to https://hollywooddiqitalblueprint.com/hjvdhuidv/wsoft.html via a direct external link from the frontend. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the primary button. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and reference the newly generated background image as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend involvement).
acceptanceCriteria: At least one generated image is present under frontend/public/assets/generated and is used by the new page background.
No image fetching is routed through the backend canister.

file_operations.description: Add the required generated static background image asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/reference-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.
Reference the static generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/reference-bg.dim_1920x1080.png directly in the UI as the bottom background layer (no backend fetching).
